macros.name: autofootnoterule
macros.doc: Footnote rule is right or left aligned based on the direction of the first footnote following the rule (i.e. put in the current page).

macros.name: debugfootnotedirection
macros.doc: Writes the direction of the first footnote on each page, to the terminal and the log file.

macros.name: leftfootnoterule
macros.doc: Footnote rule is always left aligned.

macros.name: loadnewlatinfont
macros.doc: Loads new Latin font.

macros.name: loadnewparsifont
macros.doc: Loads new Parsi font.

macros.name: LTRfootnote
macros.doc: Always typesets left to right footnote independent on the current mode.

macros.name: LTRthanks
macros.doc: Behaves like \LTRfootnote but only should be used inside \title and \author arguments.

macros.name: rightfootnoterule
macros.doc: Footnote rule is always right aligned.

macros.name: RTLfootnote
macros.doc: Always typesets right to left footnote independent on the current mode.

macros.name: RTLthanks
macros.doc: Behaves like \RTLfootnote but only should be used inside \title and \author arguments.

macros.name: setLTRpar
macros.doc: Makes the direction of the paragraph left to right. The command does not change the current font.

macros.name: setmainlatinfont
macros.doc: Chooses the main Latin font. If you do not use this command at least once, then “Latin Modern” fonts will be used instead.

macros.name: setmainparsifont
macros.doc: Chooses the main Parsi font. If you do not use this command at least once, then you get an error asking you to choose the main Parsi font.

macros.name: setmathparsidigitfont
macros.doc: Chooses the Parsi font for digits in math mode.

macros.name: setmathsfparsidigitfont
macros.doc: Chooses the Parsi font for digits in math mode inside \mathsf command.

macros.name: setmathttparsidigitfont
macros.doc: Chooses the Parsi font for digits in math mode inside \mathtt command.

macros.name: setRTLpar
macros.doc: Makes the direction of the paragraph right to left. The command does not change the current font.

macros.name: SplitFootnoteRule
macros.doc: Puts a full-width rule above the split-off part of a split footnote.

macros.name: textLatin
macros.doc: Typesets short left to right texts in right to left paragraphs. The command changes the curent font to Latin font.

macros.name: textLRE
macros.doc: Typesets short left to right texts in right to left paragraphs. The command does not change the current font.

macros.name: textParsi
macros.doc: Typesets short right to left texts in left to right paragraphs. The command changes the current font to Parsi font.

macros.name: textRLE
macros.doc: Typesets short right to left texts in left to right paragraphs. The command does not change the current font.

macros.name: textwidthfootnoterule
macros.doc: Full-width footnote rule.

envs.name: latinpar
envs.doc: Makes the direction of the paragraph left to right. The environment changes the current font to Latin font.

envs.name: LTRpar
envs.doc: Makes the direction of the paragraph left to right. The environment does not change the current font.

envs.name: parsipar
envs.doc: Makes the direction of the paragraph right to left. The environment changes the current font to Parsi font.

envs.name: RTLpar
envs.doc: Makes the direction of the paragraph right to left. The environment does not change the current font.
